brief: A herb planter of three cells side by side, each with a bin that drains.

requirements.requirement: Three cells side by side in a row
requirements.evidence: piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full placed at q=-1,0,1 along same r=0, level 0, joined by jointBolt:0#0,0#0 and jointBolt:0#0,0#3

requirements.requirement: Each cell has a bin that drains
requirements.evidence: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain - all variant hex-bin-full-drain (full depth, drained) providing drainage for herb planting

finish.summary: Built 3-cell linear planter at (-1,0,0), (0,0,0), (1,0,0) with a full-depth drained bin in each cell. Joint bolts lock the row and mesh check is clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
